post.text:
Interested in health leadership opportunities?

The Ministry is supporting a virtual information session on the 2027–28 Harkness Fellowship, in partnership with the Commonwealth Fund and Health New Zealand. Applications open 1 June 2026.

Register below to learn more (links in the comments below).
